stem: Which of the following was implemented in 1913 to solve these problems?

options.label: A
options.text: Each state held party conventions in order to select senators.

options.label: B
options.text: A national referendum was held to standardize the procedures for selecting senators.

options.label: C
options.text: Open primaries were used to limit the choices of senators who could be confirmed by state legislatures.

options.label: D
options.text: A constitutional amendment was ratified that required senators to be elected directly by popular vote.

visual_elements: • All senators were chosen by state legislatures, but states used different procedures to select them.
• Intimidation and bribery of state legislators were often used to influence the selection of senators.
• Deadlocked legislatures were often unable to select senators, leaving vacancies for several years.
